pieces.Text: [CAPACITY: 40; USAGE: 2/round] You gain a fly speed of 30 feet (average maneuverability). You can use this for "cruising flight" at a usage of only 1 charge per minute, but you are flat-footed and off-target while doing so. Changing from normal flight to cruising flight or vice versa is a standard action. A jetpack can't lift you if you're encumbered. This upgrade can be installed only in light or heavy armor.
